title: Single-Use Bureau-Runtime-Refresh nach PR #2172 mit Source-Precondition
goal: Execute exactly one new source- and target-bound Bureau runtime refresh to the freshly observed protected heimgewebe/bureau main after this authority itself is merged as one create-only TaskSpec and adopted missing-only into the authoritative StateStore. The selected target must contain PR #2172 merge f879af9cd9fd7a6f26cc28dec273399e27a8e582. The sole purpose is to converge the immutable Bureau runtime from the live registered source deeaf24cc4178f088cc19d211a93a69fb7b09d13 to that fresh protected main while enforcing the source-precondition contract introduced by PR #2172. This authority grants no queue, claim, dispatch, product-code, foreign-work or general repository authority.

approval.note: Single-use target-bound bootstrap only. The explicit 2026-08-25 operator instruction authorizes autonomous convergence of Bureau after merged PR #2172. No runtime effect may start until fresh protected-main/CI observation, exact target binding, authoritative TaskSpec preflight, typed deployment/Registry source identity and Git ancestry preconditions, live intent-bound leases and runtime-refresh readback gates all pass. Repeat the source precondition immediately before apply. No blind retry after any effect-started ambiguity.

acceptance.assertion: Immediately before prepare-intent and again before apply, protected GitHub main is freshly observed; the exact selected target contains f879af9cd9fd7a6f26cc28dec273399e27a8e582 as an ancestor and contains this authority's protected merge. Required checks for the exact target, including validate (3.10), validate (3.12) and the registry registration freshness gate where applicable, are successful. Any target drift invalidates the candidate before effect.

Immediately before prepare-intent and again immediately before apply, the active deployment manifest and canonical Registry both report the same installed source identity. The manifest digest is the registered digest a063a7090dbf07650ec119e54ea54e28c975f86cb6c5dbedf15d1361cfe07216 unless a fresh verified source-to-target ancestor transition permitted by the contract is proven. The installed source is exactly the registered source deeaf24cc4178f088cc19d211a93a69fb7b09d13 or is independently proven by git merge-base --is-ancestor to be an ancestor of the freshly selected target. Any identity mismatch, unrelated or diverged source history, unavailable ancestry proof, stale target or manifest drift blocks the effect fail-closed.

This exact create-only TaskSpec is published through a normal protected pull request. After merge, the exact main TaskSpec bytes, TaskSpec SHA256, publication PR and publication merge commit are independently read back. StateStore adoption uses only the typed bureau-runtime-refresh adopt-authority missing-only transition and must refuse any pre-existing foreign or conflicting StateStore revision.

This authority starts at most one runtime effect. Failed, unclear, timeout or transport-ambiguous outcomes are read back from observation, intent, attempt, result, manifest, launcher, package, snapshot and authority-consumption evidence before any further action; no blind retry is permitted.

After a successful refresh, independently read deployment manifest, immutable release identity, installed package/launcher identity and canonical Registry snapshot bind the same source commit. That source contains f879af9cd9fd7a6f26cc28dec273399e27a8e582, StateStore/Registry/runtime identity is consistent, required Bureau services and timers are healthy, and Bureau/Grabowski doctor surfaces report no refresh-created failure.

The runtime-refresh result is bound to this exact authority revision/digest, observation, target, intent and attempt. The authority is consumed exactly once after successful immutable readback; no second refresh effect exists. Own refresh leases are released by the typed result-bound release path. This authority grants no queue, dispatch, unrelated claim, task-supply, foreign-work, product-code or general repository mutation authority.

rollback.strategy: The currently integrity-valid deployed Bureau runtime remains authoritative until a new immutable result is fully read back. If publication/adoption, source identity, ancestry, target freshness, lease binding or apply outcome is unclear, preserve all precondition, observation, intent, attempt, result, workspace, backup, manifest, Registry, StateStore, authority and lease evidence and do not retry blindly. Reconciliation requires the typed existing recovery path or a separately authorized successor; never rewrite single-use history.

metadata.source: Direct operator instruction on 2026-08-25 to finish runtime convergence after merged Bureau PR #2172. Fresh live observation showed protected main f879af9cd9fd7a6f26cc28dec273399e27a8e582 and installed Bureau source deeaf24cc4178f088cc19d211a93a69fb7b09d13 with matching deployment-manifest and canonical Registry source identities.

publication_path.reason: The installed immutable Bureau release predates protected main PR #2172, and the normal stale runtime cannot itself provide a new exact source-preconditioned StateStore authority without bootstrapping. Therefore exactly one create-only TaskSpec is published through protected GitHub review and, after merge, adopted missing-only through the typed runtime-refresh adoption contract. No queue or live StateStore state is mutated by the Git publication itself.
does_not_establish: runtime effect before protected merge and missing-only adoption
